_comment: Edit this file to customize your wedding invitation. Refresh the page after changes.

venue.name: Park City Resort
venue.address: Malout, Fazilka Rd, Malout Rural, Punjab 152107, India

footer.message:
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
ਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
— With the blessings of Waheguru, we joyfully invite you to celebrate the Wedding!

seo.description: Nirman & Simran invite you to their Wedding Reception on 6 December 2026 at Park City Resort, Malout. With the blessings of Waheguru, we joyfully invite you to celebrate!

features._comment: Toggle optional features without editing code.

qr._comment: QR codes shown on the page, the PDF card, and print. mapUrl opens venue directions; the contact QR is a vCard for Nirman (his phone) with the venue address.

rsvpWhatsApp.defaultMessageEn: I'm replying to the Wedding Reception of Nirman & Simran on 6 December 2026.
rsvpWhatsApp.defaultMessagePa: ਸਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ! ਨਿਰਮਾਣ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਦੀ 6 ਦਸੰਬਰ 2026 ਦੀ ਵਿਆਹ ਰਿਸੈਪਸ਼ਨ ਲਈ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਵਾਬ:

rsvpForm.noteEn: Your RSVP will open in WhatsApp — just press send to confirm.
rsvpForm.notePa: ਤੁਹਾਡਾ RSVP ਵਟਸਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹੇਗਾ — ਭੇਜੋ ਦਬਾ ਕੇ ਪੱਕਾ ਕਰੋ।

photos._comment: Photo section disabled by features.photoSection. Leave empty.

background._comment: Subtle background options. Set enabled:true and pick one style.

i18n._comment: Add languages here. 'en' is the default. Add a 'lang' toggle button and the page will switch strings.
